Hi Daniel — great to meet you yesterday and thanks for the note. Looping in Marissa and Ben from Partnerships/RevOps so we can move to a concrete draft.

High-level proposal to start the conversation (open to adjustments):

1) Revenue share (embedded / OEM):
   - First 12 months: 65/35 (LumenForge/Redwood) on gross software revenue tied to embedded usage.
   - Renewals: 60/40 (LumenForge/Redwood) starting year 2; exceptions for strategic accounts (TAM > $250k) to be handled case-by-case.

2) Tiering by ACV:
   - <$25k ACV: standard split (as above)
   - $25k-$250k ACV: +5% to Redwood for partner enablement (i.e., 60/40 -> 55/45 or similar)
   - >$250k ACV: negotiate uplift and potential co-sell credit

3) Lead registration and protection:
   - Window: 90 days from first qualified demo or signed NDA (whichever earlier).
   - Definition: qualified lead = legal company + named AE + confirmed budget stage (proposal or POC).
   - Required Fields for registration: company, AE, ARR estimate, qualifying notes, first-touch timestamp.

4) Validation flow and evidence:
   - Partner must register in HubSpot (link below) and provide one of: demo recording, signed NDA, or email intro. Redwood will validate within 5 business days.

5) Payment cadence & clawbacks:
   - Quarterly settlements with 45-day payment terms. 12-month clawback for credits/refunds tied to gross revenue deductions.

Next steps: Ben — can you attach a draft partner_terms_draft.xlsx with the split matrix and a sample MOP? Marissa — would you be available for a 60-minute working session Thursday 11/30?

We can also run a short 1-hour governance workshop with LumenForge product/GTMs to finalize operational handoffs.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

> 1) Revenue share (embedded / OEM): 65/35 first year, 60/40 renewals...

Thanks Mina — this is a great starting point. A couple of suggested tweaks from ops/legal/enablement POV:

- Tiering: rather than a flat +5% to Redwood for mid-tier, create explicit bands and a credit schedule so payouts are predictable (I sketched a matrix in the attachment).
- Lead validation: require the registering partner to include the first-demo recording or an intro email chain. If Redwood delivered the first demo, partner credit reduces by 50%.
- Net-new definition: customer not in Redwood CRM within the past 24 months.
- Co-sell credit: for deals where Redwood-owned AE closes the opportunity, offer LumenForge a referral fee rather than embedded revshare to avoid double-counting.

Ben — I added a sample CSV format for inflows that RevOps can consume; can you review and confirm settlement cadence?

Daniel — Thurs 11/30 10:00-11:00 PT works for me for the workshop — sending a calendar invite.

Cheers,
